polls.description: Chinese AI companies and robotics firms are surging with major market debuts, competitive models, and international expansion amid US-China tech tensions.
polls.question: Is China's AI surge a threat to US tech dominance or healthy competition?

cluster_stories.title: China Axing Microsoft Windows From State Agencies Ahead of Plan
cluster_stories.summary: China is pulling the plug on an older version of Microsoft Corp.’s Windows tailored for government agencies, taking another step toward rooting out the world’s most popular PC software in a broader effort to reduce its dependence on foreign technology.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AXES MICROSOFT WINDOWS From Government Agencies

cluster_stories.title: Unitree Robotics Surges in Shanghai Debut
cluster_stories.summary: Unitree Robotics shares surged in their Shanghai trading debut after the company raised 6.1 billion yuan in an initial public offering, becoming the first listed humanoid robot maker in mainland China. Bloomberg's Peter Elstrom joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: UNITREE ROBOTICS SURGES IN SHANGHAI DEBUT... First Listed Humanoid Maker

cluster_stories.title: Baidu’s Apollo Go is now on Uber in Dubai, with no safety driver
cluster_stories.summary: Uber has put Baidu’s driverless robotaxis on its app in Dubai. Book an UberX or an Uber Comfort there now and the app may match you with an Apollo Go vehicle that has nobody in it. A dedicated “Autonomous” option raises the odds for anyone who wants one on purpose. The service went live on […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU DRIVERLESS ROBOTAXIS HIT UBER IN DUBAI

cluster_stories.title: Baidu CEO vows to return Ernie to AI frontier as revenue miss sinks shares
cluster_stories.summary: Its Ernie ​large language model has gone months without a major ⁠upgrade, while ‌competitors such as Alibaba and Moonshot have continued to roll ​out newer versions ​of their models.
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU SHARES SINK as Ernie Falls Behind Alibaba, Moonshot

cluster_stories.title: Chinese humanoid robot maker surges 600% in trading debut
cluster_stories.summary: Unitree makes stellar start in Shanghai as investors clamour for shares
cluster_stories.headline: Chinese Robot Maker ROCKETS 600% on Trading Debut

cluster_stories.title: Humanoid-maker Unitree surges more than 600% on Shanghai debut
cluster_stories.summary: Shares in Chinese robotics pioneer Unitree soared more than 600 percent on its debut in Shanghai on Wednesday, after raising more than $900 million in its initial public offering. On its debut Wednesday, the company's stock spiked as much as 629 percent to 1,100 yuan at the open, compared with its offering price of 150.80 yuan.
cluster_stories.headline: UNITREE SOARS 600% in Shanghai Debut After $900M Raise

cluster_stories.title: Why China's DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot Are a Worry for US AI Rivals
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI models are cheaper and more adaptable than the preeminent US platforms, and studies suggest they’re now almost as proficient. How did that happen?
cluster_stories.headline: DeepSeek and Chinese AI Models RIVAL US Platforms

cluster_stories.title: Unitree IPO: Why Investors Are Betting Big on China’s Humanoid Robots
cluster_stories.summary: Robots built to move, work and act like humans. It’s a global industry Morgan Stanley estimates could be worth $5 trillion by 2050. It’s also one of the frontiers in the China-US race for technological supremacy.
cluster_stories.headline: Humanoid Robots: China's $5 Trillion Bet Against US

cluster_stories.title: Unitree Shares Jump After $904M Shanghai IPO | The China Show | 8/19/2026
cluster_stories.summary: “Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: Humanoid Robot Maker Unitree Surges in $904M IPO

polls.description: Anthropic's rapid revenue growth and massive credit facility signals imminent IPO for OpenAI's major competitor.

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Annualized Revenue Tops $65 Billion Before IPO
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $65 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, up more than sevenfold from its pace at the end of last year. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC REVENUE HITS $65B BEFORE IPO—Up 7X in Months

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility to Rise Over $10 Billion
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic's revolving credit facility is anticipated to rise above its approximately $10 billion target, according to sources. That's a substantial increase over a $2.5 billion five-year facility the AI company secured last year, though discussions are still ongoing. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Ed Ludlow with the details on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC PRE-IPO CREDIT FACILITY EXCEEDS $10BN TARGET

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility Set to Climb Past $10 Billion
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC’s revolving credit facility is set to rise above its roughly $10 billion target, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence firm prepares for a highly anticipated initial public offering.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC IPO INCOMING: Credit Facility Surges Past $10 Billion

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Revenue Surges as IPO Speculation Builds
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News. This comes as speculation builds around a potential IPO. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz breaks down the latest financial figures and how they compare with OpenAI’s growth. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC REVENUE SURGES 14X... IPO INCOMING
